source_evidence: Publisher metadata lists names, Document and Topic_group, but supplies no class inclusion/exclusion or annotation rules.

Access.include: Ordinary account activation, sign-in, authentication, password/MFA, ordinary application or resource access permissions.
Access.exclude: Explicit administrative/root/sudo/elevated privileges; storage capacity or recovery; unspecified software failures.

Administrative rights.include: Grant, revoke or use explicitly privileged admin/root/sudo/elevated roles or execution.
Administrative rights.exclude: Ordinary login/password resets; ordinary file-share permissions without administrative elevation; a generic application failure.

Hardware.include: Explicit physical equipment fault, damaged component, power failure or physical device replacement due to a fault.
Hardware.exclude: Unspecified software, email or network service failure; a purchase order; an issue where physical fault is not established.

Storage.include: Storage quota/capacity, file backup or recovery, storage volume/disk data integrity and file persistence.
Storage.exclude: A user lacks permission to open a share (Access); privileged ACL administration (Administrative rights); unspecified application failure.

Purchase.include: Procurement, supplier quote/order/invoice, buying or commercially renewing equipment/software licenses.
Purchase.exclude: Repair only; activate an already-owned license without a procurement request; unrelated payroll.

HR Support.include: Personnel, leave, payroll, benefits or employment record/process requests.
HR Support.exclude: A generic HR application login problem (Access); generic software failure without an HR business-process request.

Internal Project.include: Explicit planning, milestones, staffing or coordination of a planned internal IT project/change program.
Internal Project.exclude: Ordinary incidents or requests merely mentioning a project/customer name; an unspecified 'project' keyword.

Miscellaneous.include: Explicit general service-desk process, contact, opening-hours, ticket-status/duplicate closure or general IT service information.
Miscellaneous.exclude: Not a fallback for missing context, ambiguous intent, network/software incidents or categories absent from this proposal.

unresolved_statuses.INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT: Text cannot establish a primary request or decisive class evidence.
unresolved_statuses.OUT_OF_SCOPE: Clear request, but generic software/network/other issue has no justified class in this eight-class proposal.
unresolved_statuses.MULTI_INTENT: Two independently actionable intents require different classes; no supported primary request.
unresolved_statuses.TAXONOMY_REVIEW: Class boundary or scope must be decided by the domain owner.
unresolved_statuses.SOURCE_LABEL_CONFLICT: Identical normalized source text has conflicting original service labels; quarantine before pilot.

annotation_rules: Use the full provided text, including negations. Never infer absent intent from product names alone.
Do not see model predictions, confidence scores or source service labels while assigning a provisional label.
Give one short rationale grounded in visible text. Record ambiguity explicitly instead of forcing a class.
All AI annotations remain provisional; human adjudication and an approved taxonomy are required before any audit export.
The pilot is development data; never use it as a new independent risk/audit set.
